transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Tuesday, September 8. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. 'North pole and south pole': Nehra compares Shubman Gill and Hardik Pandya. Shubman Gill took over as Gujarat Titans captain after Hardik Pandya left the franchise. He led the team to the IPL final in 2026, after Pandya and Nehra had guided GT to the title in their first season in 2022 and another final in 2023. Nehra said Gill and Pandya are very different personalities and leaders, but both have the ability to keep learning. Government clears rupees 1.1 lakh crore proposals to buy military hardware. Rajnath: 98 percent To Be Sourced From Local Cos Republican mayor rejects 'Lake America' name; says locals take renaming personally. The Republican mayor of Oswego has firmly opposed President Trump's executive order to rename Lake Ontario, emphasizing the importance of the lake's original name in shaping the community's identity. This decision has sparked bipartisan and international discontent among numerous political leaders, especially with the recent downturn in Canadian tourism to the U.S. Locals will persist in using the lake's historical name, rooted in Indigenous heritage. Eiffel Tower closes after female staff 'sidelined' during Hindu group's visit. NEW DELHI: The Eiffel Tower was closed to visitors on Monday after staff staged a walkout over allegations that female employees were moved away from their workstations during a visit by a Hindu religious group linked to the Bochasanwasi Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Sanstha (BAPS), as reported by Euronews. India joins US, 24 nations in push for next-generation 6G networks. NEW DELHI: India has joined the United States and 24 other countries in an initiative aimed at shaping the development of next-generation 6G networks, the US department of commerce said. Company can face fine for offence carrying jail term: SC. NEW DELHI: A company having no physical body cannot be imprisoned and having no mind cannot possess mens rea (guilty mind), which is essential for conviction in a criminal case. 100 years later, daughter still runs cafe where mom earned 5 cents a day at 16. South Bend's Sunny Italy Cafe, established in 1926, is celebrating its centennial anniversary. This historic eatery has remained under family ownership for a full century. The restaurant is renowned for its authentic, scratch-made Italian dishes and traditional recipes. Generations of Notre Dame students and local residents have frequented the establishment. Town keeps Jesse James gang member's ear 150 years after failed 1876 heist. In a dramatic seven-minute standoff in Northfield, Minnesota, local citizens bravely confronted the notorious James-Younger Gang during a bank heist, ultimately leading to the gang's capture. Today, the Northfield Historical Society preserves fascinating artifacts, including an outlaw's duster and even a mummified ear from that fateful day. The town now honors this brave moment in history with a lively annual festival. AI may soon help humans talk to animals and birds. Artificial intelligence may soon enable humans to communicate with animals. Researchers are cataloguing and reproducing animal sounds using machine learning models. This technology raises ethical questions about animal privacy and potential misuse. Understanding animal signals could lead to manipulation and distress for wildlife. Bangladesh and India plan to resume train ops by October. DHAKA: Bangladesh and India plan to resume cross-border train operations through the Maitree, Mitali and Bandhan Express trains by Oct and the annual meeting of railway authorities of the two countries beginning Tuesday will work in that direction, officials have said. Parents who display kids' achievements may be doing more than showing pride. Showcasing children's drawings and achievements brings about numerous psychological rewards. It conveys to youngsters that their contributions are important. This recognition nurtures a sense of capability and belonging. Praising effort instead of natural talent encourages a development-focused mindset. Supreme Court judge writes 4th letter to CJI against Raj HC judge. NEW DELHI: Supreme Court Judge Sandeep Mehta has written another letter to Chief Justice of India Surya Kant alleging that Rajasthan high court judge Sanjeev Prakash Sharma, who was replaced as the Acting Chief Justice of Rajasthan high court, was interfering in an internal judicial enquiry by abusing administrative powers.
